[0] Although memory costs are expected to easily become the single largest line item in the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same may not be true of the iPhone Duo. Here's what we know so far.

[1] Apple signs three-year exclusive deal with Samsung Display

[2] Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple has signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

[3] The leaker stated that Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successors," with each panel costing approximately $250.

[4] The leaker also noted that this is "undoubtedly one of the most expensive core components of the device."

[5] While no reliable numbers have been disclosed for the iPhone Duo's expected bill of materials, Apple has shared the device's material information based on a breakdown of the costs of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components, as well as the proportion of recycled materials used.
